finalOotRule: open exactly once after immutable finalist receipt; never retune Gen 1 from its result

population.drawNoContestCancellation: exclude from binary target with counts retained

primarySelection.ensembleMateriality: at least 0.003 Validation log-loss gain over both members and no Brier degradation
primarySelection.guardrails: Validation Brier no worse than Elo and ECE no more than 0.005 worse
primarySelection.simplicityTie: within 0.002 log loss choose ELO, LOGISTIC, HGB, then ENSEMBLE

probabilitySemantics: P(canonical fighter A wins conditional on a decisive result)
